summary: LiveOne, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the departure of CFO Ryan Carhart effective May 1, 2026, to pursue another opportunity, with no dispute. The company appointed Craig Christensen as Interim CFO, Treasurer, Secretary, and Principal Accounting Officer, also for subsidiaries PodcastOne and Slacker. Christensen brings over 25 years of financial leadership experience, most recently as CFO of 180 Health Services. The change is orderly with a transition plan in place. Watch for potential further executive moves and the search for a permanent CFO.
